[{"insert":"Sumo Deadlift

The sumo deadlift uses a wide stance with the feet turned out and hands gripping inside the legs. This position shortens the pull distance and shifts more demand onto the hips and inner thighs compared to a conventional setup. Keep the chest up and drive your feet apart as the bar leaves the ground. Reps drop across the odd weeks so the weight goes up each time it returns.
"}]
